edges.reason: Caller-controlled mint amount determines the mint loop and limit checks.
block.timestamp decides whether the presale or public phase rules apply.
msg.sender is the minter, whitelist subject and balance-tracking key.
PRESALE_COST may be assigned to the local mintCost during presale.
PUBLIC_COST initialises the local mintCost.
PUBLICT_MINT_AMOUNT initialises the local maxMintAmount.
PRESALE_MINT_AMOUNT may replace the local maxMintAmount.
Local mintCost is used in the msg.value sufficiency check.
Local maxMintAmount drives the raffle-eligibility wallet limit check.
MAX_SUPPLY bounds the total mintable token count.
MAX_PRESALE bounds the presale mintable token count.
RESERVE_SUPPLY is subtracted from the public/presale caps.
PRESALE_MINT_DATE gates entry into the whitelist-only presale branch.
PUBLICSALE_MINT_DATE terminates the presale window.
WLIST is read to enforce the presale whitelist requirement.
addressMintedBalance is read to enforce per-wallet mint limits.
addressRaffle receives the caller when the wallet reaches its cap.
tokenIdCounter is read for supply limit checks.
mint writes the increased per-address minted balance after the mint loop.
mint pushes the caller into the raffle array on cap crossing.
mint increments the token id counter for each minted NFT.
mint calls _safeMint for each token, triggering the receiver callback path.
Loop counter i drives the per-token mint loop.
Requested token id is validated and appended to the URI.
block.timestamp decides whether the hidden or revealed URI is served.
PRESALE_MINT_DATE is the reveal cutoff.
notRevealedUri is returned before reveal.
baseURI is read via _baseURI for revealed token metadata.
tokenURI calls the internal _baseURI accessor.
_baseURI returns the stored baseURI state variable.
Owner-supplied amount drives the reserved mint loop.
msg.sender (owner) receives the reserved NFTs.
reserveTokenIdCounter is read for the reserve cap check.
RESERVE_SUPPLY bounds owner reserve minting.
tokenIdCounter supplies the next token id for reserved mints.
reserveMint increments the reserve counter.
reserveMint increments the main token counter.
reserveMint calls _safeMint and triggers receiver callbacks.
raffle reads addressRaffle length to index the winner.
raffle derives the winner index from the timestamp-based random().
unicTokenIdCounter is read for the unique NFT cap check.
UNIC_SUPPLY bounds the number of raffle prizes.
Selected winner address is the mint recipient.
raffle increments the unique token counter.
raffle safe-mints the prize to the winner address.
raffle invokes the internal random() generator.
random() mixes block.timestamp, a miner-influenced value.
random() hashes the public addressRaffle array as entropy.
random() produces the weak, predictable randomness flagged as an unsafe operation.
onlyOwner ties withdraw execution to the owner msg.sender.
withdraw performs an external value call to owner(), the callback-capable unsafe operation.
New base URI string supplied by the owner.
onlyOwner restricts setBaseURI to the owner msg.sender.
setBaseURI assigns the new value to baseURI.
New hidden URI string supplied by the owner.
onlyOwner restricts setNotRevealedURI to the owner msg.sender.
setNotRevealedURI assigns the new value to notRevealedUri.
Address array processed by the whitelist loop.
onlyOwner restricts whitelist additions to the owner msg.sender.
addToWhiteList sets WLIST entries to true.
Constructor iterates the initial whitelist array.
Constructor seeds WLIST from the supplied addresses.
Constructor sets tokenIdCounter._value to 7.
Constructor calls setBaseURI during initialisation.
Constructor calls setNotRevealedURI during initialisation.
_safeMint delegates receiver verification to _checkOnERC721Received.
The operator argument forwarded to onERC721Received is _msgSender().
Recipient contract can re-enter mint() through the onERC721Received callback before addressMintedBalance is updated.
Recipient contract can re-enter reserveMint() through the onERC721Received callback.
Recipient contract can re-enter raffle() through the onERC721Received callback before the unique counter cap is enforced.

normalization_plan.reason: Caller-supplied mint count is only meaningful inside mint() where it drives limit checks and the mint loop.
Token id argument is only consumed by tokenURI() for existence checks and URI assembly.
Owner reserve amount is only used by reserveMint() to bound and drive its loop.
New base URI string exists solely as the input of the setBaseURI setter.
New hidden URI string exists solely as the input of the setNotRevealedURI setter.
Address array is only iterated by addToWhiteList() to populate WLIST.
Initial whitelist array is consumed only by the constructor seeding loop.
Temporary price selection local used only within mint() for the msg.value check.
Temporary wallet-cap local used only within mint() for the raffle eligibility condition.
Temporary winner address exists only inside raffle() as the mint recipient.
Loop index local scoped entirely to the mint() batch loop.
